column2: Invest in an Endless mastery node.
Field six demons during a dungeon run.
Successfully extract from a dungeon run.
Win floor 3 or higher with an open team slot.
Own at least one demon of every rarity.
Own at least one demon of every type.
Own all six rarities of one demon type.
Max every trainable stat on one demon.
Bind your soul to a Forsaken Shrine.
Return to a bound shrine after an ambush defeat.
Stop a hunt with your Soul Vessel completely full.
Receive a buff from the Whispering Well.
Win an encounter at World Terror 20 or higher.
Reach an edge of the world map.
Win a PvP challenge without losing a demon.
